problem.title: Tired of counting days on the calendar?
problem.text: Thursday is a holiday, so do you take Friday? Or save the day for next month's long weekend? Flip enough calendar pages and you end up taking whatever day is free, and by December the leftover PTO just disappears. Goldweek does the counting and shows you the days that stretch your PTO the furthest.

features.title: Your PTO at a glance
features.text:
See your total, used and remaining days on one screen. It also shows how far into the year you are next to how much PTO you've used, so you know right away if you're saving too much.
Your remaining days and upcoming time off sit right on your Home Screen in a widget.

features.title: Add time off right on the calendar
features.text:
Holidays, PTO and suggested breaks all show up on the calendar in their own colors. Tap a date to add or edit time off, including half days, quarter days and hours.
You can also import past leave in one go from a photo of your HR screen.

features.title: Your country, your schedule
features.text:
Public holidays for 42 countries, from the US, the UK and Canada to Europe, Asia and Latin America. Where holidays vary by state or region, pick yours. Country not listed? Add your own holidays.
You can also set your weekend days, the first day of the week, and fixed, part-time or shift work.

items.q: My leave balance doesn't look right.
items.a: Check the month your leave year starts and your total annual leave in Settings. Half days (0.5) and quarter days (0.25) are deducted automatically, and types that don't count against your balance, such as sick leave, official leave and business trips, don't change it. If it still looks wrong, email us.

items.q: My time off doesn't show up on the calendar.
items.a: Cancelled time off isn't shown on the calendar. Check the entry's status in Leave Management. Updating to the latest version can also help.

items.q: How do I add bonus leave?
items.a: Tap + in the Status tab to open Leave Management, then use Bonus Leave at the bottom. Choose a type (such as comp days, reward leave or refresh leave), enter the number of days and, if you like, an expiration date. Bonus leave is tracked separately from your regular PTO.
Tap Restore Purchase at the bottom of the Settings tab. Your purchase is restored with the Apple Account you're signed in to on the App Store. If that doesn't work, email us.

items.q: Will I lose my data if I delete the app?
items.a: Your data is stored on your device, so deleting the app removes it for good. Turn on iCloud Backup to keep a copy you can restore later.

items.q: Can I add my own holidays or hide existing ones?
items.a: Yes. In Holidays & Breaks in Settings, you can add your own holidays or hide any of the default ones.

Goldweek includes public holidays for 42 countries. Choose your country (and your state or region, where holidays differ) in Settings, and the calendar updates right away. If yours isn't listed, add its holidays yourself or ask us to support it by sending feedback from the app.
What you enter stays on your device or in your own iCloud. We only receive anonymous usage statistics, anonymous crash reports and any feedback you choose to send.
